# OmniOperand (omnioperand.com)
> High-precision quantitative computing engine, bidirectional geometric solvers, and exact radical mathematical derivations.

## Overview
OmniOperand provides rigorously verified computational solvers across Pure and Applied Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Construction Engineering, and Physiological Bio-Quant. Each tool offers closed-form algebraic solutions, exact radical constants, step-by-step proofs, zero floating-point approximation drift, and automated machine API endpoints.

## Commercial API & Autonomous AI Agent Services
- [REST API & OpenAPI 3.1 Schema](https://omnioperand.com/api/): Full machine-readable schema for ChatGPT Custom Actions, Claude MCP, and autonomous AI agents.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server](https://omnioperand.com/mcp/schemas.json): Stdio and HTTP MCP server exposing deterministic mathematical tools with explicit system prompts.
- [Developer & Enterprise Pricing](https://omnioperand.com/pricing/): Metered API tiers (Free: 500 req/mo, Pro: 50,000 req/mo at $29/mo, Enterprise: $199/mo).
- [Embeddable Widgets (CaaS)](https://omnioperand.com/embed/): Standalone zero-dependency calculator widget engine with isolated Shadow DOM.

## Domain Hubs
- [Quantitative Finance & Lending Hub](https://omnioperand.com/finance/): Calculators for mortgages, debt refinancing, HELOCs, real estate underwriting, tax liabilities, and compound interest models.
- [Construction & Trades Engineering Hub](https://omnioperand.com/construction/): High-precision solvers for concrete volumes, framing, aggregate tonnage, roofing squares, HVAC thermal loads, and electrical circuits.
- [Health, Nutrition & Bio-Quant Hub](https://omnioperand.com/health/): Clinical and athletic physiological engines: BMR, TDEE, macronutrients, body fat percentages, hydration, and pharmacokinetics.
- [Geometry & Spatial Analysis Hub](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/): 2D and 3D geometric solvers: regular polygons, conic sections, polyhedra, surfaces of revolution, and radical closed-form proofs.
- [Physics & Engineering Mechanics Hub](https://omnioperand.com/physics/): Classical Newtonian kinematics, ballistics, electromagnetism, Ohm's law, fluid mechanics, and harmonic oscillation solvers.
- [Calculus & Mathematical Analysis Hub](https://omnioperand.com/calculus/): Computational engines for differentiation, integration, quadratic roots, linear systems, and algebraic structures.
- [Probability & Statistics Hub](https://omnioperand.com/statistics/): Stochastic models, probability mass/density functions, parameter estimation, z-scores, combinatorics, and Bayesian inference.

## Mathematical Invariants & Analytical Formulas

### Mortgage Refinance & Breakeven Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/refinance/`)
- Governing Formula: `Breakeven Months = Total Closing Costs / (Current Payment - New Payment)`
  - **Monthly Amortization Derivation**: Monthly payments M are computed using the annuity equation: M = P · [i(1 + i)ⁿ] / [(1 + i)ⁿ - 1], where i = r / 12 and n = years × 12.
  - **Monthly Cash Flow Differential**: Monthly payment savings ΔM = M_current - M_new. If ΔM > 0, the homeowner captures immediate monthly liquidity.
  - **Capital Recovery & Breakeven Horizon**: The exact time in months to recover closing costs C is: T_breakeven = C / ΔM. If the homeowner remains in the home longer than T_breakeven, refinancing yields positive economic surplus.
  - **Net Lifetime Wealth Impact**: Net lifetime savings = (Total remaining payments under old loan) - (Total payments under new loan + closing costs).

### HELOC (Home Equity Line of Credit) Payment Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/heloc/`)
- Governing Formula: `Interest-Only Payment = (Balance · Annual Rate) / 12`
  - **Interest-Only Cash Flow During Draw Period**: During the draw period (typically years 1–10), the borrower pays strictly accrued interest: M_draw = B · (r / 12), where B is drawn balance and r is variable APR.
  - **Payment Reset Upon Amortization Period**: At month (draw_years × 12) + 1, the draw period closes and the loan resets into full principal amortization: M_repay = B · [i(1 + i)ᵐ] / [(1 + i)ᵐ - 1], where m = repay_years × 12.
  - **Payment Shock Sensitivity**: Payment shock is defined as ΔM_reset = M_repay - M_draw. Borrowers must anticipate this mandatory jump when the draw window concludes.

### Debt-to-Income (DTI) Ratio Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/dti/`)
- Governing Formula: `Back-End DTI = (Total Monthly Debt Obligations / Gross Monthly Income) × 100%`
  - **Gross Monthly Income Derivation**: Gross Monthly Income GMI = Gross Annual Income / 12.
  - **Front-End Housing Ratio**: Front-End DTI = (Proposed Housing Payment PITI / GMI) × 100%. Conventional lending benchmarks target <= 28%.
  - **Back-End Total Debt Ratio**: Back-End DTI = [(Housing PITI + Auto + Student + Credit Cards) / GMI] × 100%. Qualified Mortgage (QM) limits set the strict upper bound at 43% to 45%.

### Loan-to-Value (LTV) Ratio & PMI Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/ltv/`)
- Governing Formula: `LTV = (Loan Balance / Appraised Property Value) × 100%`
  - **LTV Mathematical Definition**: LTV = (Mortgage Principal / Appraised Value) × 100%.
  - **Homeowner Protection Act Statutory Threshold**: Under the federal Homeowners Protection Act of 1998, borrowers may request PMI cancellation at 80% LTV, and lenders must automatically terminate PMI at 78% LTV on the original amortization schedule.
  - **Capital Required for PMI Removal**: Paydown Target = Current Balance - (Appraised Value × 0.80).

### FHA Loan & Mortgage Insurance (MIP) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/fha-loan/`)
- Governing Formula: `Total Financed Loan = Purchase Price - Down Payment + (Base Loan × 1.75% UFMIP)`
  - **Down Payment & Base Loan**: Down Payment = Price × Down_Pct. Base Loan = Price - Down Payment.
  - **Upfront Mortgage Insurance Premium (UFMIP)**: FHA requires an upfront premium of 1.75%: UFMIP = Base Loan × 0.0175. This is customarily financed directly into the loan.
  - **Annual Monthly MIP**: For LTV > 95% on 30-year terms, annual MIP is 0.55%: Monthly MIP = (Total Financed × 0.0055) / 12.

### VA Loan Payment & Funding Fee Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/va-loan/`)
- Governing Formula: `Total Financed Loan = Purchase Price + (Purchase Price × Funding Fee %)`
  - **Zero Down Payment Benefit**: VA loans provide 100% financing with zero down payment requirement: Base Loan = Price - Down Payment.
  - **Statutory VA Funding Fee**: VA Funding Fee = Base Loan × Fee_Rate (2.15% for first-time use with 0% down; 0% for service-connected disability).
  - **Monthly PMI Exemption**: Unlike conventional and FHA mortgages, VA loans carry zero monthly mortgage insurance premiums, delivering substantial monthly savings.

### Reverse Mortgage (HECM) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/reverse-mortgage/`)
- Governing Formula: `Principal Limit = Home Value × Principal Limit Factor (Age, Rate)`
  - **Maximum Claim Amount (MCA)**: MCA = min(Appraised Home Value, FHA National HECM Lending Limit $1,149,825).
  - **Principal Limit Factor (PLF)**: The actuarial factor PLF is determined by HUD tables based on the age of the youngest borrower and the expected interest rate. (Approx. 40% at age 62 up to 65% at age 85).
  - **Net Proceeds Resolution**: Net Available = (MCA × PLF) - Mandatory Existing Mortgage Payoff - Closing Costs.

### Personal Loan & Debt Consolidation Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/personal-loan/`)
- Governing Formula: `M = P · [r(1 + r)ⁿ] / [(1 + r)ⁿ - 1]`
  - **Fixed Installment Math**: Using standard fixed amortization: M = P · [r(1 + r)ⁿ] / [(1 + r)ⁿ - 1], where r = APR / 1200.
  - **Total Cost of Borrowing**: Total Outlay = M × n. Total Interest = (M × n) - P.

### Student Loan Refinancing Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/student-loan-refinance/`)
- Governing Formula: `Total Interest Saved = Lifetime Old Interest - Lifetime Refinanced Interest`
  - **Current Loan Stream**: M_old = P · [r₁(1 + r₁)ⁿ¹] / [(1 + r₁)ⁿ¹ - 1]. Total_old = M_old × n₁.
  - **Refinanced Stream**: M_new = P · [r₂(1 + r₂)ⁿ²] / [(1 + r₂)ⁿ² - 1]. Total_new = M_new × n₂.
  - **Net Interest Reduction**: Savings = Total_old - Total_new.

### Credit Card Payoff & Interest Snowball Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/credit-card-payoff/`)
- Governing Formula: `Months to Pay Off = -ln[1 - (P · i / M)] / ln(1 + i)`
  - **Logarithmic Payoff Inversion**: From B_(t+1) = B_t(1 + i) - M, solving for n yields: n = -ln[1 - (B · i) / M] / ln(1 + i), where i = APR / 12.
  - **Minimum Threshold Invariant**: If M <= B · i, monthly payments fail to cover interest accrual, causing infinite debt expansion.

### Boat Loan Financing & Payment Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/boat-loan/`)
- Governing Formula: `Financed Principal = Boat Price - Down Payment + Sales Tax`
  - **Marine Down Payment Deduction**: P = Boat Price × (1 - Down_Pct / 100).
  - **Extended Term Amortization**: Because boats are durable luxury assets, marine loans extend up to 20 years (240 months). Installment: M = P · [r(1 + r)ⁿ] / [(1 + r)ⁿ - 1].

### RV Loan & Motorhome Financing Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/rv-loan/`)
- Governing Formula: `M = P · [r(1 + r)ⁿ] / [(1 + r)ⁿ - 1]`
  - **Financed Balance Computation**: P = RV_Price - Down_Payment.
  - **Amortization Resolution**: M = P · [i(1 + i)ⁿ] / [(1 + i)ⁿ - 1], where i = APR / 12 and n = years × 12.

### Motorcycle Loan & Financing Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/motorcycle-loan/`)
- Governing Formula: `M = P · [r(1 + r)ⁿ] / [(1 + r)ⁿ - 1]`
  - **Financed Principal**: P = Price - Down_Payment.
  - **Monthly Amortization**: M = P · [r(1 + r)ⁿ] / [(1 + r)ⁿ - 1].

### Solar Loan & Energy Payoff Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/solar-loan/`)
- Governing Formula: `Net System Cost = Gross System Cost - 30% Federal Tax Credit`
  - **Inflation Reduction Act 30% ITC Credit**: Federal Residential Clean Energy Credit = Gross Cost × 0.30. Net Cost = Gross Cost × 0.70.
  - **Solar Loan Amortization**: M_solar = Net_Cost · [i(1 + i)ⁿ] / [(1 + i)ⁿ - 1].
  - **Day-One Positive Cash Flow**: Monthly Savings = Electric Bill - M_solar.

### Commercial Real Estate Mortgage Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/commercial-mortgage/`)
- Governing Formula: `M = P · [r(1 + r)ⁿ] / [(1 + r)ⁿ - 1] (with Balloon at Year t)`
  - **Extended Amortization Baseline**: Commercial loans customarily amortize over 25 or 30 years to maintain workable debt-service coverage: M = P · [r(1 + r)ⁿ] / [(1 + r)ⁿ - 1].
  - **Balloon Balance Invariant**: At loan maturity (typically 5, 7, or 10 years), the entire unamortized principal balance B_t is due in full or refinanced.

### DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/dscr-loan/`)
- Governing Formula: `DSCR = Net Operating Income (NOI) / Annual Debt Service`
  - **Net Operating Income**: NOI = Gross Rental Revenue - Operating Expenses (Taxes, Insurance, HOA).
  - **Debt Service Ratio**: DSCR = NOI / Monthly Debt Service (P&I). Ratios >= 1.25 qualify for prime pricing.

### Cap Rate (Capitalization Rate) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/cap-rate/`)
- Governing Formula: `Cap Rate = (Annual Net Operating Income / Current Market Value) × 100%`
  - **NOI Derivation**: Annual NOI = Gross Scheduled Rent - Operating Expenses.
  - **Unleveraged Yield Invariant**: Cap Rate = (Annual NOI / Property Asset Value) × 100%. Represents the unleveraged rate of return.

### Rental Property Cash Flow & ROI Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/rental-cash-flow/`)
- Governing Formula: `Cash-on-Cash Return = (Annual Net Cash Flow / Total Cash Invested) × 100%`
  - **Reserve Budgeting**: Reserves = Monthly Rent × (CapEx_Pct / 100).
  - **Net Monthly Flow**: Cash Flow = Rent - Mortgage - Taxes/Ins - Reserves.
  - **Cash-on-Cash Formula**: CoC = (Annual Cash Flow / Total Cash Invested) × 100%.

### BRRRR Real Estate Investment Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/brrrr/`)
- Governing Formula: `Cash Left in Deal = (Purchase + Rehab Costs) - New Refinance Loan (75% ARV)`
  - **Total Initial Investment**: All-In Capital = Purchase Price + Rehab Budget + Holding Costs.
  - **Cash-Out Refinance Invariant**: New Loan = ARV × Refi_LTV. Cash Left = All-In Capital - New Loan. If Cash Left <= 0, the investor achieves an infinite return on capital.

### Hard Money & Fix-and-Flip Loan Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/hard-money-loan/`)
- Governing Formula: `Total Financing Cost = (Loan Amount · Origination Points %) + Monthly Interest · Term`
  - **Origination Points**: Points Fee = Loan Amount × (Points_Pct / 100).
  - **Monthly Interest Holding Cost**: Monthly Interest = Loan Amount × (Rate / 1200).
  - **Total Loan Cost**: Total = Points Fee + (Monthly Interest × Months).

### Roth IRA Conversion & Tax Optimizer (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/roth-ira-conversion/`)
- Governing Formula: `Future Tax-Free Advantage = FV_Roth - (FV_Traditional - Future Taxes)`
  - **Upfront Tax Obligation**: Tax Due = Conversion Amount × Current Marginal Tax Rate.
  - **Compounding Symmetry**: If tax rates are identical today and in retirement, Traditional and Roth produce mathematically equal net wealth. If future tax rates rise (t_future > t_current), Roth conversion produces significant tax alpha.

### Traditional vs Roth 401(k) / IRA Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/traditional-vs-roth/`)
- Governing Formula: `Roth Wealth = P · (1 - t_0) · (1 + r)ⁿ vs Traditional Wealth = [P · (1 + r)ⁿ] · (1 - t_n)`
  - **Mathematical Equivalence Under Constant Tax**: Because multiplication is commutative: A(1 - t)(1 + r)ⁿ ≡ A(1 + r)ⁿ(1 - t). The decision hinges strictly on whether t_current > t_retirement or vice versa.

### Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/rmd/`)
- Governing Formula: `RMD = Account Balance as of Dec 31 / IRS Distribution Period`
  - **SECURE Act 2.0 Starting Age**: RMDs commence at age 73 (rising to age 75 in 2033).
  - **IRS Table Division**: Annual RMD = Prior Dec 31 Balance / Distribution Factor (from IRS Pub 590-B Table III).

### Dividend Reinvestment (DRIP) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/drip/`)
- Governing Formula: `Total Shares(t+1) = Shares(t) + [Dividends Paid / Share Price]`
  - **Share Accumulation Mechanism**: Reinvesting dividends purchases incremental shares without capital transaction fees, increasing the share base that earns next quarter's dividend.
  - **Yield on Cost Multiplication**: Yield on Cost = (Annual Dividend at Year t / Initial Investment) × 100%.

### FIRE Calculator (Financial Independence, Retire Early) (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/fire/`)
- Governing Formula: `FIRE Number = Annual Living Expenses / Safe Withdrawal Rate (e.g. Expenses × 25)`
  - **The Trinity Study 4% Invariant**: FIRE Target = Expenses / SWR. Under a 4.0% SWR, Target = Expenses × 25. Under a conservative 3.33% SWR, Target = Expenses × 30.
  - **Logarithmic Annuity Inversion**: Solving FV = PV(1 + r)ⁿ + PMT · [((1 + r)ⁿ - 1) / r] for n yields the exact years to reach financial independence.

### Social Security Benefit & Age Optimizer (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/social-security/`)
- Governing Formula: `Monthly Benefit = PIA × (1 ± Actuarial Adjustment Factor)`
  - **Early Claiming Reduction (Age 62-66)**: Claiming early at age 62 reduces your PIA by 30% permanently (5/9 of 1% per month for first 36 months + 5/12 of 1% for remaining).
  - **Delayed Retirement Credits (Age 67-70)**: Delaying past FRA yields an 8.0% guaranteed real increase per year up to age 70 (max +24%).

### Pension Annuity vs Lump Sum Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/pension-vs-lump-sum/`)
- Governing Formula: `Required Hurdle Rate = Internal Rate of Return (IRR) Equating Lump Sum to Annuity`
  - **Present Value Equivalence**: PV_annuity = PMT · [1 - (1 + r)⁻ⁿ] / r. Solving for r establishes the hurdle return your portfolio must achieve net of fees to outperform the pension.

### Certificate of Deposit (CD) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/cd-calculator/`)
- Governing Formula: `CD Balance = Principal · [1 + (APY / 100)]^(Months / 12)`
  - **Compound Interest Formulation**: FV = P · [1 + r/m]ᵐᵗ. APY expresses the effective annualized compounding return.

### High-Yield Savings Account (HYSA) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/hysa/`)
- Governing Formula: `Future Value = P(1 + r/365)³⁶⁵ᵗ + PMT · [((1 + r/12)¹²ᵗ - 1) / (r/12)]`
  - **Daily Compounding Mechanics**: HYSA accounts credit interest monthly but compound daily using: Effective Rate = (1 + APY)^(1/365) - 1.

### Inflation & Purchasing Power Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/inflation/`)
- Governing Formula: `Future Cost = Present Cost · (1 + Inflation Rate)ⁿ`
  - **Exponential Purchasing Power Degradation**: Purchasing Power Factor = 1 / (1 + i)ⁿ. At a 3.2% annual rate over 20 years, $1.00 degrades to $0.53.

### Rule of 72 Investment Doubling Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/rule-of-72/`)
- Governing Formula: `Years to Double ≈ 72 / Interest Rate % (Exact: ln(2) / ln(1 + r))`
  - **Mathematical Derivation from Natural Logarithms**: 2P = P(1 + r)ⁿ ⟹ ln(2) = n · ln(1 + r) ⟹ n = ln(2) / ln(1 + r). For small r, ln(1 + r) ≈ r, and ln(2) ≈ 0.6931. Using 72 provides maximum integer divisibility.

### Stock Option & RSU Vesting Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/stock-option-rsu/`)
- Governing Formula: `Pre-Tax Value = Vested Shares × Market Price per Share`
  - **RSU Ordinary Income Event**: Upon vesting, RSUs are treated as supplemental W-2 earned income: Gross = Vested Shares × Stock Price. Taxes are automatically withheld by selling shares to cover.

### Crypto Profit & Capital Gains Tax Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/crypto-profit-tax/`)
- Governing Formula: `Capital Gain = Selling Price - Cost Basis - Transaction Fees`
  - **IRS Property Classification**: Under IRS Notice 2014-21, cryptocurrency is classified as property. Every trade, swap, or sale triggers a taxable realization event.

### Capital Gains Tax Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/capital-gains-tax/`)
- Governing Formula: `Capital Gain = Sale Proceeds - Cost Basis`
  - **Realization Event**: Taxable Gain = Proceeds - Adjusted Basis. Unsold unrealized gains incur zero tax liability.

### 1099 Self-Employment Tax (SECA) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/self-employment-tax/`)
- Governing Formula: `SE Tax = Net Earnings × 92.35% × 15.3% (Social Security + Medicare)`
  - **Net Self-Employment Earnings**: Net Earnings = Gross Revenue - Allowable Business Expenses.
  - **The 92.35% Multiplier**: IRS rules assess SECA tax on 92.35% of net profit (reflecting the employer portion deduction): Taxable SE Base = Net × 0.9235.
  - **15.3% SECA Tax Rate**: Social Security (12.4% up to wage base) + Medicare (2.9% uncapped) = 15.3%.

### Salary to Hourly Wage Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/salary-to-hourly/`)
- Governing Formula: `Hourly Wage = Annual Salary / 2,080 Hours (40 hrs/wk × 52 weeks)`
  - **Standard Work Year Constant**: Annual Hours = Hours_per_Week × Paid_Weeks. Standard: 40 × 52 = 2,080 hours.
  - **Direct Wage Resolution**: Hourly Rate = Salary / Annual Hours.

### Hourly to Salary Wage Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/hourly-to-salary/`)
- Governing Formula: `Annual Salary = (Base Hourly × 2,080) + (Overtime Hours × 1.5 × Hourly × 52)`
  - **FLSA Overtime Multiplier**: The Fair Labor Standards Act requires 1.5x pay for hours worked over 40 in a workweek: OT_Rate = Base × 1.5.
  - **Total Annual Compensation**: Annual = (Regular_Hrs × Base × 52) + (OT_Hrs × Base × 1.5 × 52).

### Sales Commission & Quota Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/commission/`)
- Governing Formula: `Total Payout = Base Salary + (Base Commission) + (Accelerated Over-Quota Commission)`
  - **Attainment Percentage**: Attainment = (Sales Volume / Quota Target) × 100%.
  - **Tiered Accelerators**: Sales up to quota are paid at the base rate. Sales above quota are multiplied by the enhanced accelerator rate.

### Break-Even Point Analysis Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/break-even/`)
- Governing Formula: `Break-Even Units = Fixed Costs / (Price per Unit - Variable Cost per Unit)`
  - **Contribution Margin Derivation**: Unit Contribution Margin CM = Price - Variable_Cost. CM Ratio = CM / Price.
  - **Break-Even Volume Invariant**: At break-even, Total Revenue = Total Cost ⟹ Q × P = Fixed + Q × V ⟹ Q_be = Fixed / (P - V).

### Margin vs Markup Multiplier Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/margin-markup/`)
- Governing Formula: `Margin % = Markup / (1 + Markup) vs Markup % = Margin / (1 - Margin)`
  - **Mathematical Divergence**: Margin = (Price - Cost) / Price. Markup = (Price - Cost) / Cost. Margin can never exceed 100%, whereas Markup can exceed 1,000%.

### Square Footage & Area Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/square-footage/`)
- Governing Formula: `Square Footage = Length (ft) × Width (ft)`
  - **Quadrilateral Area Formula**: Area of a rectangular surface is given by A = L × W. For non-rectangular zones, divide into composite rectangles and sum the partial areas.
  - **Square Yards Dimensional Conversion**: Since 1 yard = 3 feet, 1 square yard = 9 square feet. Therefore: Area (sq yd) = Area (sq ft) / 9.
  - **Linear Perimeter Derivation**: Perimeter around the boundary is P = 2(L + W), providing baseboard, framing, or fencing material requirements.

### Concrete Slab & Footing Volume Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/concrete-slab/`)
- Governing Formula: `Cubic Yards = [Length (ft) × Width (ft) × (Thickness (in) / 12)] / 27`
  - **Dimensional Volumetric Conversion**: Convert slab thickness from inches to feet: h_ft = thickness / 12. Volume in cubic feet is V_cf = L × W × h_ft.
  - **Cubic Yards Derivation**: One cubic yard contains 3 × 3 × 3 = 27 cubic feet: V_cy = V_cf / 27.
  - **Waste Adjustment and Bag Factorization**: Total ordered volume includes waste factor: V_total = V_cy · (1 + waste/100). One 80lb bag yields ~0.60 cu ft, and one 60lb bag yields ~0.45 cu ft.

### Paint Coverage & Gallons Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/paint-coverage/`)
- Governing Formula: `Gallons = [(Total Wall Area - Cutouts) × Number of Coats] / 350 sq ft`
  - **Gross Wall Surface Area**: Total gross perimeter wall area is A_gross = 2 × (Length + Width) × Height.
  - **Cutout Deductions**: Deduct window and door openings: A_cutouts = (doors × 21) + (windows × 15). Net paintable wall area is A_net = A_gross - A_cutouts.
  - **Gallon Consumption Model**: One standard gallon covers approximately 350 to 400 square feet. Gallons required = (A_net × coats) / 350.

### Flooring & Tile Quantity Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/flooring/`)
- Governing Formula: `Total Ordered Sq Ft = Room Area × (1 + Waste Percentage / 100)`
  - **Net Area Calculation**: Room area A_net = Length × Width.
  - **Waste Allowance Integration**: End cuts, mistakes, and awkward room borders require additional material: A_gross = A_net · (1 + waste/100).
  - **Box Quantization**: Flooring is sold strictly by whole unopened cartons: Boxes = ceil(A_gross / box_coverage).

### Drywall Sheet & Joint Compound Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/drywall/`)
- Governing Formula: `Sheets = (Total Wall Area + Ceiling Area) / Sheet Area`
  - **Total Enclosing Envelope Area**: Wall area = 2 × (L + W) × H. Ceiling area = L × W. Total area = Wall area + Ceiling area.
  - **Sheet Yield and Waste Factor**: With a standard 10% cutting waste factor, Sheets = ceil[(Total Area × 1.10) / Sheet Size].
  - **Fasteners and Mud Consumables**: Drywall sheets require approximately 32 screws per 4×8 panel (~12" edge and 16" field spacing). Mud consumes ~0.053 gallons per square foot.

### Gravel & Crushed Stone Tonnage Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/gravel/`)
- Governing Formula: `Tons = [Cubic Yards × 1.4 Tons/cu yd]`
  - **Geometric Volumetric Integral**: V_cf = Length (ft) × Width (ft) × [Depth (in) / 12]. Cubic yards V_cy = V_cf / 27.
  - **Density Gravimetric Conversion**: Aggregate tonnage: T = V_cy × Density. Dense graded aggregate typically weighs ~2,800 lbs per cubic yard (1.4 US tons).
  - **Compaction Settling Variable**: Vibrated crush-and-run aggregate settles approximately 15% to 20% under a plate compactor roller.

### Mulch & Soil Volume Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/mulch/`)
- Governing Formula: `Cubic Yards = [Bed Area (sq ft) × Depth (in)] / 324`
  - **Dimensional Divisor Derivation**: One cubic yard = 27 cu ft = 27 × 12 = 324 board-feet. Therefore, 1 cubic yard covers exactly 324 square feet at 1 inch depth.
  - **Cubic Yardage Formula**: Cubic Yards = (Area × Depth_inches) / 324.
  - **Retail Bag Equivalence**: Since 1 cubic yard = 27 cubic feet: 2 cu ft bags = ceil(cuft / 2), and 3 cu ft bags = ceil(cuft / 3).

### Patio Paver & Polymeric Sand Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/pavers/`)
- Governing Formula: `Paver Units = Area (sq ft) / Paver Area (sq ft) × 1.10`
  - **Paver Surface Area**: Single paver area A_p = (paver_length × paver_width) / 144 sq ft.
  - **Total Unit Count with Cutting Waste**: Units = ceil[(Patio Area / A_p) × 1.10]. The 10% allowance covers perimeter split cutting.
  - **Sub-Base Stratification**: ICPI standards mandate: 4 inches compacted road base gravel (#21A) + 1 inch uncompacted concrete sand bedding.

### Sod & Turf Pallet Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/sod-turf/`)
- Governing Formula: `Pallets Needed = [Lawn Sq Ft × 1.05] / Pallet Sq Ft (Typically 450)`
  - **Surface Boundary Area**: Net lawn area A = Length × Width.
  - **Cutting Waste Cushion**: Add 5% for standard rectilinear lawns (or 10% for curved beds): A_order = A × 1.05.
  - **Pallet Yield Calculation**: Pallets = ceil(A_order / pallet_coverage). A typical pallet contains 50 rolls (10 sq ft each = 500 sq ft) and weighs ~2,000 to 2,500 lbs.

### Retaining Wall Block & Backfill Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/retaining-wall/`)
- Governing Formula: `Blocks = [Wall Length (ft) × Wall Height (ft)] / Block Face Area (sq ft)`
  - **Buried Base Course Consideration**: Retaining walls require 1 course buried beneath finished grade for stability: Total Course Height = Height + (block_height / 12).
  - **Block Face Yield**: Block face area A_b = (block_length × block_height) / 144 sq ft. Total Blocks = ceil[(Wall Length × Total Height) / A_b] × 1.05.
  - **Hydrostatic Drainage Calculus**: Retaining walls fail due to water pressure. A 12-inch clear gravel drainage chimney is placed behind the wall: V_gravel = Length × Height × 1.0 ft.

### Deck Framing & Joist Spacing Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/deck-framing/`)
- Governing Formula: `Joist Count = ceil[Deck Width (in) / On-Center Spacing (in)] + 1`
  - **Joist Layout Algorithm**: Joists run perpendicular to the ledger board. Number of joists = ceil[(Deck Length × 12) / Spacing] + 1 (for end rim joist).
  - **Decking Board Quantity**: Boards run parallel to the house across joists. Effective board width with 1/8" gap = 5.625". Boards = ceil[(Deck Projection × 12) / 5.625].
  - **Beam Post Support Calculation**: Drop beams require 6×6 support posts spaced no more than 8 feet apart under standard 50 psf total load.

### Fence Post, Rail & Picket Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/fence-post/`)
- Governing Formula: `Posts = ceil[Fence Length / Post Spacing] + 1`
  - **Post Interval Derivation**: Number of sections = ceil(Fence Length / Post Spacing). Number of posts = Sections + 1 (plus 1 additional post per gate).
  - **Rail Count Formula**: Total 2×4 rails = Sections × Rails per section.
  - **Picket Density Calculation**: Pickets = ceil[(Fence Length × 12) / Picket Width] × 1.05 for solid privacy fencing.

### Asphalt Driveway Tonnage & Cost Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/asphalt-driveway/`)
- Governing Formula: `Asphalt Tons = [Area (sq ft) × Depth (in) × 110 lbs/sq yd/in] / 2,000`
  - **Square Yardage Transformation**: Area in square yards: A_sy = (Length × Width) / 9.
  - **Asphalt Paving Density Constant**: Compact hot mix asphalt weighs approximately 110 lbs per square yard per inch of thickness (145 lbs/cu ft).
  - **Tonnage Derivation**: Tons = (A_sy × Depth_in × 110) / 2000. Add 5% for edge tamping compaction margin.

### Brick & Mortar Quantity Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/brick-mortar/`)
- Governing Formula: `Modular Bricks = Wall Area (sq ft) × 6.85 Bricks/sq ft`
  - **Wall Surface Calculation**: Wall Face Area A = Wall Length × Wall Height.
  - **Brick Density with Standard 3/8" Mortar Joint**: A standard modular brick (3-5/8" × 2-1/4" × 7-5/8") with 3/8" joint yields 6.85 bricks per square foot: Bricks = ceil[A × 6.85 × 1.05].
  - **Mortar Consumption Heuristic**: One 80 lb bag of pre-mixed masonry mortar lays approximately 125 to 140 modular bricks.

### Board Feet (FBM) & Lumber Price Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/lumber-board-feet/`)
- Governing Formula: `Board Feet = [Thickness (in) × Width (in) × Length (in)] / 144`
  - **Board Foot Volume Definition**: One board foot equals 144 cubic inches (a 1-inch thick board measuring 12 inches wide by 12 inches long).
  - **Dimensional Calculation with Length in Feet**: BF = [Thickness (in) × Width (in) × Length (ft)] / 12.
  - **Monetary Tally**: Total Board Feet = BF_single × Quantity. Total Order Price = Total Board Feet × Price per BF.

### Roofing Shingles & Bundles Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/roofing-shingles/`)
- Governing Formula: `Roofing Squares = [Footprint Sq Ft × Pitch Multiplier] / 100`
  - **Roof Pitch Pythagorean Multiplier**: The pitch factor secant: M_pitch = √[1 + (pitch / 12)²]. For a 6/12 pitch, M_pitch = √(1 + 0.25) = 1.118.
  - **True Geometric Slope Area**: True Area = Footprint × M_pitch. Order Area = True Area · (1 + waste/100).
  - **Roofing Square and Bundle Quantization**: One roofing square = 100 square feet. Architectural shingles pack 3 bundles per square: Bundles = Squares × 3.

### HVAC Air Conditioner BTU & Tonnage Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/ac-btu-tonnage/`)
- Governing Formula: `Cooling Tons = Total Required BTU / 12,000 BTU/ton`
  - **Base Sensible Heat Load by Climate**: Base load varies by zone: Zone 1 = 26 BTU/sqft, Zone 2 = 23 BTU/sqft, Zone 3 = 20 BTU/sqft, Zone 4 = 17 BTU/sqft, Zone 5 = 15 BTU/sqft.
  - **Height and Occupancy Corrections**: BTU = [Area × Base_Rate × (Ceiling / 8)] + (Occupants × 400). Kitchen areas add 1,200 BTU.
  - **HVAC Tonnage Derivation**: One ton of refrigeration equals 12,000 BTU/hr (heat required to melt 1 ton of ice in 24 hours): Tons = BTU / 12,000. Round to standard 0.5-ton increments.

### Heating BTU & Furnace Sizing Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/heating-btu/`)
- Governing Formula: `Furnace BTU = Home Area (sq ft) × Heating Factor (BTU/sq ft)`
  - **Heating Degree Day Zone Classification**: Zone 1 (Mild): 30 BTU/sqft; Zone 2 (Moderate): 35-40 BTU/sqft; Zone 3 (Cold): 45 BTU/sqft; Zone 4 (Very Cold): 50 BTU/sqft; Zone 5 (Sub-Zero): 60 BTU/sqft.
  - **Net Thermal Demand**: Net Demand BTU_out = Area × Heating Factor.
  - **AFUE Efficiency Rating Adjustment**: Furnaces are labeled by fuel input rate: Input BTU = Net Output BTU / (AFUE / 100).

### Solar Panel Array Sizing & kWh Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/solar-sizing/`)
- Governing Formula: `System Size (kW) = [Annual kWh / (Sun Hours × 365)] / Derate Factor`
  - **Daily Electrical Energy Consumption**: Target annual energy = (Monthly kWh × 12) × (Offset% / 100). Daily demand E_daily = Annual kWh / 365.
  - **System Derate and Inverter Losses**: DC-to-AC inverters, wiring resistance, and temperature degradation create an industry standard 0.80 derate factor: kW_DC = E_daily / (Peak Sun Hours × 0.80).
  - **Panel Count and Roof Footprint**: Panels = ceil[(kW_DC × 1000) / Panel Wattage]. Each modern 400W panel occupies approximately 18 square feet.

### Tankless Water Heater GPM & Sizing Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/tankless-water-heater/`)
- Governing Formula: `Required GPM = Sum of Concurrent Fixture Flow Rates`
  - **Peak Concurrent Flow Calculus**: GPM_total = (showers × 2.0) + (sinks × 1.0) + (appliances × 1.5).
  - **Thermal Rise Derivation**: To deliver standard 120°F domestic hot water: ΔT = 120°F - Inlet Water Temp (°F).
  - **Thermodynamic Heat Input**: Water heating energy equation: BTU/hr = GPM × ΔT × 500 (since 1 gal water = 8.33 lbs, 8.33 × 60 = 500). Gas units assume 82% efficiency: BTU_in = BTU / 0.82.

### Electricity Cost & Appliance kWh Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/electricity-cost/`)
- Governing Formula: `Cost = [Watts × Hours Run / 1,000] × Utility Rate ($/kWh)`
  - **Kilowatt-Hour Integral**: Energy consumption in kilowatt-hours: kWh_daily = (Watts × Daily Hours) / 1,000.
  - **Monthly and Annual Scaling**: Monthly kWh = kWh_daily × 30. Annual kWh = kWh_daily × 365.
  - **Monetary Utility Assessment**: Cost = Total kWh × Utility Rate ($/kWh).

### Voltage Drop & Wire Gauge (AWG) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/wire-gauge-drop/`)
- Governing Formula: `Voltage Drop (VD) = [2 × K × I × Length (ft)] / Circular Mils (CM)`
  - **Ohm's Law for Long Run Conductors**: Voltage Drop V_d = 2 × K × I × L / CM, where K = 12.9 ohms-cmil/ft for copper at 75°C, I is current in amps, L is one-way distance in feet, and CM is circular mils.
  - **Conductor Circular Mil Cross-Sections**: 14 AWG = 4,110 CM; 12 AWG = 6,530 CM; 10 AWG = 10,380 CM; 8 AWG = 16,510 CM; 6 AWG = 26,240 CM; 4 AWG = 41,740 CM.
  - **NEC Maximum Drop Recommendation**: National Electrical Code (NEC) Section 210.19(A) recommends that voltage drop not exceed 3% on branch circuits and 5% total across feeder and branch combined.

### Generator Sizing & Starting Watts Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/generator-sizing/`)
- Governing Formula: `Generator Size = Total Running Watts + Largest Motor Surge Watts`
  - **Inductive Motor Inrush Current**: Compressors and pumps require 2 to 3 times their running power during the first 2 to 3 seconds of startup to establish magnetic rotor fields.
  - **Simultaneous Surge Rule**: Calculate running load by summing all continuous devices. Then add only the SINGLE largest motor startup surge, since probability of multiple motors starting on the exact same millisecond is near zero.
  - **Safety Operating Headroom**: Generators should not operate continuously at 100% capacity. Add a 20% safety margin: Generator kW = Peak Load × 1.20.

### Insulation R-Value & Batt Roll Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/insulation-r-value/`)
- Governing Formula: `Total Batts = Total Cavity Area / Area per Batt`
  - **Thermal Resistance Definition**: R-value measures conductive heat flow resistance: R = ΔT / (Heat Flux Q). Higher R-values indicate greater thermal insulation.
  - **Fiberglass Thickness Equivalence**: Standard fiberglass batt delivers approximately R-3.14 per inch of thickness: Thickness = Target R-Value / 3.14.
  - **Roll Package Quantization**: Packages = ceil(Area / Roll Coverage). Add 5% for cavity end trimming.

### Concrete Rebar Grid & Weight Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/rebar-calculator/`)
- Governing Formula: `Linear Feet = [(Length / Spacing + 1) × Width] + [(Width / Spacing + 1) × Length]`
  - **Bidirectional Orthogonal Grid Layout**: Number of lengthwise bars = ceil[(Width × 12) / Spacing] + 1. Number of widthwise bars = ceil[(Length × 12) / Spacing] + 1.
  - **Lap Splice and Edge Clearance Allowance**: ACI 318 requires a 30-bar-diameter lap splice (e.g. 15 inches for #4 rebar) whenever 20ft sticks are joined: Add 10% for lap splices.
  - **ASTM Weight per Foot Specifications**: #3 rebar = 0.376 lbs/ft; #4 rebar = 0.668 lbs/ft; #5 rebar = 1.043 lbs/ft; #6 rebar = 1.502 lbs/ft.

### Rain Gutter & Downspout Sizing Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/gutter-sizing/`)
- Governing Formula: `Drainage Area = Roof Area × Pitch Factor × Max Rainfall Rate (in/hr)`
  - **Roof Watershed Area Adjustment**: Roof drainage area A_d = Length × Width × Pitch Factor. Pitch factors: 4/12 = 1.05, 6/12 = 1.10, 8/12 = 1.20, 12/12 = 1.30.
  - **Rational Flow Method**: Discharge Q = (Rainfall_in/hr × A_d) / 96.23 GPM.
  - **SMACNA Gutter Sizing Heuristic**: Standard 5-inch K-style gutters handle up to 5,500 sq ft watershed with 3×4 downspouts. When watershed intensity exceeds 1,000 adjusted sq ft per 30ft run, 6-inch gutters prevent overshooting and foundation erosion.

### Trench Excavation & Soil Swell Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/construction/excavation-trench/`)
- Governing Formula: `Loose Volume (LCY) = Bank Volume (BCY) × (1 + Swell Factor / 100)`
  - **Bank Cubic Yard (BCY) In-Situ Volume**: Undisturbed compacted earth volume: V_BCY = [Length (ft) × Width (ft) × Depth (ft)] / 27.
  - **Soil Bulking and Swell Phenomenon**: When soil is excavated, air voids are introduced. Loose Cubic Yards V_LCY = V_BCY · (1 + Swell% / 100).
  - **Haul-Off Truck Capacity**: Dump trucks are sized by loose payload volume: Truckloads = ceil(V_LCY / 10 cu yd).

### Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/bmr/`)
- Governing Formula: `BMR (men) = 10W + 6.25H - 5A + 5 | BMR (women) = 10W + 6.25H - 5A - 161`
  - **Metric Mass and Stature Normalization**: Convert imperial measurements to SI units: Mass W_kg = Weight (lbs) / 2.20462. Stature H_cm = Height (in) × 2.54.
  - **Mifflin-St Jeor Metabolic Derivation**: The Mifflin-St Jeor equation: BMR = (10 × W_kg) + (6.25 × H_cm) - (5 × Age) + s, where sex constant s = +5 for biological males and -161 for biological females.
  - **Clinical Validity**: Extensive meta-analyses show the Mifflin-St Jeor formulation predicts resting metabolic expenditure within 10% of indirect calorimetry for over 82% of healthy non-obese adults.

### Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/tdee/`)
- Governing Formula: `TDEE = BMR × Physical Activity Level (PAL) Multiplier`
  - **Thermodynamic Energy Balance**: TDEE encompasses three major components: BMR (~60-70%), Thermic Effect of Food TEF (~10%), and Physical Activity Expenditure (~20-30%).
  - **PAL Standardized Multipliers**: Sedentary = BMR × 1.20; Lightly Active = BMR × 1.375; Moderately Active = BMR × 1.55; Very Active = BMR × 1.725; Extremely Active = BMR × 1.90.
  - **Adipose Caloric Equivalence**: One pound of human adipose tissue stores approximately 3,500 kcal of chemical energy. A sustained daily deficit of 500 kcal produces exactly 1 lb of fat loss per week.

### Body Mass Index (BMI) & Weight Category Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/bmi/`)
- Governing Formula: `BMI = [Weight (lbs) / Height (in)²] × 703`
  - **Quetelet Index Derivation**: BMI was formulated in 1832 by Adolphe Quetelet: BMI = Mass (kg) / Height (m)². In imperial units: BMI = [Weight (lbs) / Height (in)²] × 703.0695.
  - **WHO Diagnostic Cutoffs**: Underweight: < 18.5; Normal: 18.5–24.9; Overweight: 25.0–29.9; Class I Obesity: 30.0–34.9; Class II: 35.0–39.9; Class III: ≥ 40.0.
  - **BMI Prime Normalization**: BMI Prime = BMI / 25.0. An individual with BMI Prime < 1.0 is within the non-overweight spectrum.

### US Navy Body Fat Percentage Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/body-fat/`)
- Governing Formula: `BF% (men) = 86.010 · log10(Waist - Neck) - 70.041 · log10(Height) + 36.76`
  - **Logarithmic Circumference Model**: The US Navy equation correlates abdominal adiposity against upper neck circumference: BF% = 86.010 · log10(Waist - Neck) - 70.041 · log10(Height) + 36.76.
  - **Two-Compartment Mass Partitioning**: Fat Mass (lbs) = Weight × (BF% / 100). Fat-Free Mass (FFM) = Weight - Fat Mass.
  - **Military Standards Invariant**: US Department of Defense standard DoD 1308.3 validates this circumference approach within 3% to 4% of dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DEXA) scans.

### Macronutrient Split (Carbs, Protein, Fats) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/macro/`)
- Governing Formula: `Total Calories = (Protein × 4) + (Carbohydrates × 4) + (Fats × 9)`
  - **Caloric Density Invariants (Atwater Factors)**: Proteins and carbohydrates yield exactly 4.0 kcal per gram of combustible energy. Dietary lipids (fats) yield 9.0 kcal per gram.
  - **Gram Equivalence Transformation**: Protein Grams = (Total kcal × Protein%) / 4. Fat Grams = (Total kcal × Fat%) / 9. Carbs Grams = (Total kcal × [100 - Protein% - Fat%]) / 4.
  - **Thermic Effect of Food (TEF)**: Protein has the highest thermic cost, with 20% to 30% of ingested protein calories burned during enzymatic peptide hydrolysis.

### Calorie Deficit & Fat Loss Timeline Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/calorie-deficit/`)
- Governing Formula: `Target Date = Today + [(Weight to Lose × 3,500) / Daily Deficit] Days`
  - **Wishnofsky Adipose Rule**: One pound of human fat tissue contains ~3,500 kilocalories of stored chemical energy: Total Energy Deficit = (Weight_current - Weight_goal) × 3,500 kcal.
  - **Daily Prescribed Intake**: Daily Food Intake Target = TDEE - Daily Deficit.
  - **Temporal Projection**: Days to Goal = Total Energy Deficit / Daily Deficit. Weekly Loss Rate = (Daily Deficit × 7) / 3,500.

### Ideal Body Weight (IBW) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/ideal-weight/`)
- Governing Formula: `Devine IBW (men) = 50.0 kg + 2.3 kg × (Height in inches - 60)`
  - **Dr. Devine Pharmacological Baseline**: Originally developed in 1974 for renal clearance drug dosing: Men: 50.0 kg + 2.3 kg per inch over 5 feet. Women: 45.5 kg + 2.3 kg per inch over 5 feet.
  - **Robinson and Miller Empirical Adjustments**: Robinson (1983) and Miller (1983) modified coefficients based on updated Metropolitan Life actuarial mortality tables.
  - **Conversion to Imperial Mass**: Mass in pounds = Mass (kg) × 2.20462.

### Daily Water Intake & Hydration Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/water-intake/`)
- Governing Formula: `Daily Water (oz) = [Weight (lbs) × 0.5] + (Exercise Minutes × 0.4)`
  - **Baseline Physiological Water Turnover**: Base requirement is 0.5 fluid ounces per pound of body weight to cover respiratory, renal, and dermal insensate fluid losses.
  - **Exercise Induced Sweating Supplement**: Sweat rates during exercise average 0.5 to 1.0 liters per hour. Add 12 oz of water for every 30 minutes of vigorous training (0.4 oz/min).
  - **Dimensional Metric Conversion**: Liters = Ounces / 33.814. Standard 8-oz glass count = ceil(Ounces / 8).

### Target Heart Rate & Training Zones Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/target-heart-rate/`)
- Governing Formula: `Target HR = [(Max HR - Resting HR) × Intensity%] + Resting HR`
  - **Maximal Heart Rate Derivation**: Estimated HR_max using Tanaka formula: HR_max = 208 - (0.7 × Age).
  - **Heart Rate Reserve (HRR) Calculation**: HRR = HR_max - Resting HR. HRR reflects true physiological cardiovascular working capacity.
  - **Karvonen Multi-Zone Stratification**: Zone 1 (50-60%): Recovery; Zone 2 (60-70%): Mitochondrial endurance; Zone 3 (70-80%): Aerobic tempo; Zone 4 (80-90%): Anaerobic threshold; Zone 5 (90-100%): Maximal neuromuscular sprint.

### One Rep Max (1RM) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/one-rep-max/`)
- Governing Formula: `1RM (Epley) = Weight × (1 + Reps / 30) | 1RM (Brzycki) = Weight / (1.0278 - 0.0278 × Reps)`
  - **Epley Strength Dynamic**: Formulated by Boyd Epley in 1985: 1RM = Weight × [1 + (Reps / 30)].
  - **Brzycki Non-Linear Hyperbolic Form**: Matt Brzycki formulation: 1RM = Weight / [1.0278 - (0.0278 × Reps)].
  - **Predictive Accuracy Threshold**: Both formulas maintain high correlation (r > 0.98) when repetitions are under 10. Accuracy diminishes significantly above 12 to 15 reps due to muscle endurance bias.

### Running Pace & Race Finish Time Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/running-pace/`)
- Governing Formula: `Pace = Time / Distance | Projected Time = Distance × Pace`
  - **Temporal Decimal Conversion**: Total minutes T_min = (Hours × 60) + Minutes + (Seconds / 60).
  - **Mile and Kilometer Split Calculus**: Pace_mile = T_min / Distance (mi). Pace_km = Pace_mile / 1.60934.
  - **Riegel Race Projection Power Model**: Peter Riegel's endurance formula predicts finish times: T2 = T1 × (D2 / D1)^1.06, modeling cardiovascular fatigue over extended distances.

### VO2 Max & Aerobic Fitness Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/vo2-max/`)
- Governing Formula: `VO2 Max = 15.3 × (HR_max / HR_resting)`
  - **Maximal Heart Rate Approximation**: HR_max = 208 - (0.7 × Age).
  - **Uth-Sørensen-Overgaard-Pedersen Ratio Derivation**: Extensively validated equation based on cardiac stroke volume: VO2 Max = 15.3 × (HR_max / HR_resting).
  - **Cardiovascular Longevity Metric**: Landmark clinical studies (Mandsager et al., JAMA) show that individuals in the elite and superior VO2 max categories exhibit up to a 5-fold reduction in all-cause mortality compared to sedentary cohorts.

### Intermittent Fasting & Autophagy Schedule Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/intermittent-fasting/`)
- Governing Formula: `Fasting Window = 24 Hours - Eating Window Hours`
  - **Circadian Digestive Partitioning**: Feeding Window Hours = 24 - Fasting Hours. End of feeding window = First Meal Hour + Feeding Window Hours.
  - **Hepatic Glycogen Depletion Timeline**: Liver glycogen reserves deplete after 12 to 14 hours of caloric fasting, triggering AMPK activation and adipose lipolysis for ketone generation (acetoacetate and beta-hydroxybutyrate).
  - **Autophagy Cellular Cleanup**: Inhibition of mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) through amino acid deprivation initiates cellular macroautophagy, clearing damaged mitochondria and misfolded proteins.

### Sleep Cycle & Optimal Bedtime Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/sleep-cycles/`)
- Governing Formula: `Optimal Wake Time = Bedtime + (N × 90 Minutes) + 15 Minutes Fall-Asleep Latency`
  - **Ultradian Sleep Architecture**: Human sleep is structured into discrete 90-minute ultradian cycles transitioning through NREM Stage 1 (light), Stage 2, Stage 3 (Slow-Wave Deep Sleep), and REM (Rapid Eye Movement).
  - **Sleep Inertia Prevention**: Waking up in the middle of Stage 3 deep delta-wave sleep causes intense sleep inertia (grogginess and impaired cognitive function lasting up to 4 hours). Waking at the completion of a 90-minute cycle ensures effortless alertness.
  - **Sleep Latency Buffer**: Bedtime = Wake Time - (Cycles × 90 min) - Latency Buffer.

### Pregnancy Due Date & Gestational Age Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/pregnancy-due-date/`)
- Governing Formula: `Estimated Due Date = First Day of Last Menstrual Period + 280 Days (40 Weeks)`
  - **Naegele's Obstetric Rule**: Devised by Franz Naegele: EDD = LMP + 1 year - 3 months + 7 days, corresponding to exactly 280 days (40 full weeks) from LMP.
  - **Cycle Length Adjustment**: If cycle length deviates from 28 days: Adjusted Due Date = EDD + (Cycle Length - 28 days).
  - **Trimester Benchmarks**: First Trimester: Conception to Week 12. Second Trimester: Week 13 to Week 27. Third Trimester: Week 28 to Delivery.

### Ovulation & Fertile Window Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/ovulation/`)
- Governing Formula: `Ovulation Day = Cycle Length - Luteal Phase Length (Typically 14 Days)`
  - **Luteal Phase Constancy**: While follicular phases vary widely between individuals, the post-ovulatory luteal phase remains biologically constant at ~14 days (range 12-15 days).
  - **Ovulation Derivation**: Day of Ovulation = Cycle Length - Luteal Duration. For a 28-day cycle: 28 - 14 = Day 14. For a 32-day cycle: 32 - 14 = Day 18.
  - **Sperm Viability Window**: Human spermatozoa survive up to 5 days in cervical mucus, while an unfertilized ovum survives only 12 to 24 hours. Thus, the 6-day fertile window spans days (Ovulation - 5) through Ovulation.

### Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/bac/`)
- Governing Formula: `BAC = [Alcohol Consumed (g) / (Body Weight (g) × r)] × 100 - (β × Hours)`
  - **Standard Drink Pure Ethanol Mass**: One US standard drink contains exactly 14.0 grams (0.6 fl oz) of pure ethyl alcohol.
  - **Widmark Distribution Equation**: BAC = [Alcohol_grams / (Weight_grams × r)] × 100 - (0.015 × Hours). Distribution ratio r = 0.68 for biological men, 0.55 for biological women (reflecting higher average body fat and lower water content).
  - **Hepatic Metabolic Clearance Rate**: Human liver alcohol dehydrogenase (ADH) metabolizes ethanol at a steady zero-order kinetic rate of approximately β = 0.015% BAC reduction per hour.

### Caffeine Half-Life & Sleep Clearance Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/caffeine-half-life/`)
- Governing Formula: `Remaining Caffeine = Initial Dose × (0.5)^(Hours Elapsed / 5.0)`
  - **First-Order Elimination Kinetics**: Caffeine is metabolized by hepatic cytochrome P450 CYP1A2 enzymes following exponential decay: C(t) = C_0 · (0.5)^(t / t_half).
  - **Elimination Half-Life Variation**: In healthy adults, caffeine's elimination half-life averages 5.0 hours (range 3 to 7 hours). Oral contraceptives and pregnancy can double half-life to 10+ hours, while smoking accelerates clearance.
  - **Adenosine Receptor Antagonism**: Caffeine competitively binds to adenosine A1 and A2A receptors in the brain, blocking the natural accumulation of sleep pressure. Having more than 25-50mg circulating at bedtime reduces Stage 3 slow-wave sleep by up to 30%.

### Keto Net Carbs & Ketogenic Ratio Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/keto-carb-limit/`)
- Governing Formula: `Net Carbs = Total Carbohydrates - Dietary Fiber - Sugar Alcohols`
  - **Net Carbohydrate Glycemic Impact**: Insoluble and soluble dietary fibers pass unabsorbed through the small intestine without triggering insulin secretion: Net Carbs = Total Carbs - Dietary Fiber.
  - **Lipid Energy Balancing**: Fats provide the remaining balance of caloric energy: Fat kcal = Total kcal - (Net Carbs × 4) - (Protein × 4). Fat grams = Fat kcal / 9.
  - **Withrow-Woodyatt Ketogenic Index**: Ketogenic Ratio = Fat grams / (Protein grams + Net Carb grams). A ratio above 1.0 indicates steady nutritional ketosis; medical epilepsy diets target 3.0 to 4.0.

### Daily Protein Requirement & Muscle Synthesis Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/daily-protein/`)
- Governing Formula: `Target Protein (g) = Body Weight (lbs) × Protein Density Factor (g/lb)`
  - **Morton et al. Meta-Analysis Consensus**: Extensive meta-analysis of 49 randomized controlled trials (British Journal of Sports Medicine) demonstrated that protein intakes beyond 1.62 g/kg (0.73 g/lb) to 2.2 g/kg (1.0 g/lb) maximize fat-free mass gains in resistance-trained individuals.
  - **Leucine Trigger and Anabolic Threshold**: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is initiated via the mTORC1 pathway, requiring a per-meal threshold of approximately 2.7 to 3.5 grams of the essential amino acid leucine (found in ~30-40g high-quality whey/meat protein).
  - **Hypocaloric Nitrogen Retention**: During calorie deficits, protein demands elevate to 1.0 to 1.2 g/lb to prevent skeletal muscle catabolism.

### Smoking Cost & Pack-Years Health Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/smoking-cost/`)
- Governing Formula: `Pack-Years = (Cigarettes per Day / 20) × Years Smoked`
  - **Direct Out-of-Pocket Cash Flow**: Annual Cost = Packs per day × Cost per pack × 365. Lifetime Cash = Annual Cost × Years Smoked.
  - **Compound Opportunity Cost of Capital**: Investing the annual expenditure into an S&P 500 index fund compounding at an annualized 8%: FV = PMT · [((1 + r)ⁿ - 1) / r].
  - **Clinical Pack-Year Diagnostic Standard**: Pack-Years = Packs/day × Years. The US Preventive Services Task Force (USPSTF) recommends annual low-dose CT lung screening for individuals with a 20+ pack-year history.

### Bench Press Pyramid & Warm-Up Set Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/bench-press-pyramid/`)
- Governing Formula: `Working Set = 1RM × Target Intensity% | Plate Weight = (Barbell Weight - 45 lbs) / 2`
  - **Neural Potentiation Without Fatigue**: Warm-up pyramids potentiate motor unit recruitment via post-activation potentiation (PAP) while conserving intracellular adenosine triphosphate (ATP) and phosphocreatine.
  - **Pyramid Percentage Scaling**: Set 1: 45 lbs (empty bar) × 10 reps. Set 2: 50% working load × 6 reps. Set 3: 75% working load × 3 reps. Set 4: 90% working load × 1 rep. Set 5: 100% working set × 5 reps.
  - **Barbell Plate Math Invariant**: Olympic barbell = 45 lbs. Weight per side = (Total Weight - 45) / 2.

### Creatine Monohydrate Dosing & Saturation Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/creatine-dosing/`)
- Governing Formula: `Loading Dose = 0.3g / kg Body Weight / Day (or 20g/day) for 5-7 Days`
  - **Intramuscular Phosphocreatine (PCr) Pool**: Skeletal muscle stores approximately 120 mmol of creatine per kilogram of dry muscle. Supplementation elevates this pool by 20% to the biological ceiling of ~160 mmol/kg.
  - **Loading vs Continuous Dosing Kinetics**: Loading protocol: 20g/day split into 4 equal 5g doses for 5 to 7 days achieves maximal PCr saturation within 1 week. Continuous protocol: 3 to 5g/day reaches identical saturation levels at day 28.
  - **Intracellular Osmotic Hydration**: Creatine is an active cellular osmolyte, drawing water into muscle cells and expanding intracellular volume by 1 to 2 kg without extracellular edema.

### Total Blood Volume (Nadler) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/blood-volume/`)
- Governing Formula: `TBV (men) = 0.3669 × H³ + 0.03219 × W + 0.6041 (Liters)`
  - **Nadler's Dimensional Hemodynamic Model**: Formulated by Dr. S.B. Nadler in 1962: Men: TBV = 0.3669 × H(m)³ + 0.03219 × W(kg) + 0.6041. Women: TBV = 0.3561 × H(m)³ + 0.03308 × W(kg) + 0.1833.
  - **Height-Cubed Volumetric Scaling**: Because vascular tree capacity scales with three-dimensional body stature, height is cubed rather than squared, providing superior accuracy over simple body surface area (BSA) models.
  - **Hematocrit Partitioning**: Normal venous hematocrit partitions blood volume into ~55% liquid plasma and ~45% cellular formed elements (erythrocytes).

### Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/health/mean-arterial-pressure/`)
- Governing Formula: `MAP = Diastolic BP + [1/3 × (Systolic BP - Diastolic BP)]`
  - **Time-Weighted Cardiac Pressure Integral**: Because the human heart spends approximately two-thirds of the cardiac cycle in diastole and one-third in systole at resting heart rates, the arithmetic mean is weighted: MAP = [SBP + (2 × DBP)] / 3 = DBP + ⅓(SBP - DBP).
  - **Pulse Pressure Invariant**: Pulse Pressure PP = SBP - DBP. Pulse pressures consistently above 60 mmHg reflect increased arterial stiffness and cardiovascular disease risk.
  - **Critical Organ Perfusion Threshold**: In critical care medicine, a MAP of at least 65 mmHg is mandatory to maintain adequate capillary perfusion to vital organs (kidneys, brain, coronary arteries).

### Ellipse Area, Perimeter & Eccentricity Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/ellipse/`)
- Governing Formula: `Area = π · a · b | Perimeter ≈ π(a + b)[1 + 3h / (10 + √(4 - 3h))], where h = (a - b)² / (a + b)²`
  - **Affine Stretching Area Integral**: An ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 is the linear transformation of a unit circle x² + y² = 1 stretched by factor a horizontally and b vertically: Area = ∫∫ dx dy = π · a · b.
  - **Ramanujan's Second Perimeter Formula**: Because the exact perimeter requires an incomplete elliptic integral of the second kind E(e), Srinivasa Ramanujan formulated the famously accurate closed-form approximation: P ≈ π(a + b)[1 + 3h / (10 + √(4 - 3h))], where h = (a - b)² / (a + b)².
  - **Foci and Orbital Eccentricity**: Linear focal distance c = √(a² - b²). First eccentricity e = c / a = √(1 - b²/a²). When e = 0, the ellipse collapses to a perfect circle; as e ➔ 1, it elongates into a parabola.

### Trapezoid Area, Median & Perimeter Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/trapezoid/`)
- Governing Formula: `Area = ½(Base a + Base b) · Height | Median = ½(a + b)`
  - **Triangulation Area Proof**: Partitioning the trapezoid along a diagonal divides it into two triangles with identical altitude h and respective bases a and b: Area = ½ · a · h + ½ · b · h = ½(a + b)h.
  - **Midline Theorem**: The median connecting the midpoints of non-parallel legs is parallel to both bases with length exactly equal to their arithmetic mean: m = ½(a + b). Hence, Area = m · h.
  - **Boundary Perimeter**: Perimeter P = a + b + c + d.

### Rhombus Area, Side & Diagonals Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/rhombus/`)
- Governing Formula: `Area = ½(d₁ · d₂) | Side a = ½√(d₁² + d₂²)`
  - **Orthogonal Bisection Property**: The diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at right angles (90°), creating 4 congruent right triangles with legs d₁/2 and d₂/2.
  - **Pythagorean Side Derivation**: By the Pythagorean theorem on each quadrant triangle: a² = (d₁/2)² + (d₂/2)² = (d₁² + d₂²) / 4, yielding a = ½√(d₁² + d₂²).
  - **Diagonal Area Proof**: Sum of four right triangles: Area = 4 × [½ · (d₁/2) · (d₂/2)] = ½(d₁ · d₂). Inradius r = (d₁ · d₂) / [2√(d₁² + d₂²)].

### Parallelogram Area & Diagonals Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/parallelogram/`)
- Governing Formula: `Area = Base · Height = a · b · sin(θ)`
  - **Trigonometric Altitude and Area**: Altitude h = b · sin(θ). Therefore: Area = a · h = a · b · sin(θ).
  - **Law of Cosines for Diagonals**: Diagonal p opposite obtuse angle (180° - θ): p = √[a² + b² + 2ab cos(θ)]. Diagonal q opposite acute angle θ: q = √[a² + b² - 2ab cos(θ)].
  - **Parallelogram Law (Apollonius Identity)**: Fundamental vector invariant: p² + q² = 2(a² + b²). The sum of squares of the diagonals equals the sum of squares of all four sides.

### Kite Geometry & Area Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/kite/`)
- Governing Formula: `Area = ½(d₁ · d₂) | Perimeter = 2(a + b)`
  - **Orthodiagonal Quadrilateral Area Theorem**: Because the diagonals of a kite intersect at right angles (90°), its area is identical to half the bounding rectangle: Area = ½(d₁ · d₂).
  - **Pythagorean Pair Formulation**: Let d₂ be bisected into two equal halves (d₂/2). Top sides: a = √[(d₁_top)² + (d₂/2)²]. Bottom sides: b = √[(d₁ - d₁_top)² + (d₂/2)²].
  - **Perimeter Sum**: Perimeter P = 2(a + b).

### Cylinder Volume & Surface Area Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/cylinder/`)
- Governing Formula: `Volume = π · r² · h | Total Surface Area = 2πr(r + h)`
  - **Cavalieri's Volumetric Principle**: The volume of a right circular cylinder is the product of its circular base area and its perpendicular height: V = A_base · h = (π · r²) · h.
  - **Unrolled Net Lateral Area**: Unrolling the curved lateral boundary yields a flat rectangle with width equal to base circumference 2πr and height h: A_lateral = 2π · r · h.
  - **Total Enclosed Boundary**: Summing the lateral wall plus top and bottom circular caps: A_total = 2πrh + 2(πr²) = 2πr(r + h).

### Right Circular Cone Volume & Slant Height Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/cone/`)
- Governing Formula: `Volume = ⅓ · π · r² · h | Slant Height s = √(r² + h²)`
  - **Calculus Solid of Revolution Integral**: Revolving the line y = (r/h)x from x = 0 to h around the x-axis: V = π ∫₀ʰ (r/h)² x² dx = π(r²/h²) · [h³ / 3] = ⅓ · π · r² · h. Exactly one-third of the circumscribed cylinder volume.
  - **Pythagorean Slant Height**: The apex, center, and perimeter form a right triangle: s = √(r² + h²).
  - **Sector Unrolling for Lateral Area**: The unrolled lateral surface forms a circular sector with radius s and arc length 2πr: A_lateral = π · r · s. Total Area = πrs + πr² = πr(s + r).

### Sphere Volume & Surface Area Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/sphere/`)
- Governing Formula: `Volume = 4/3 · π · r³ | Surface Area = 4 · π · r²`
  - **Archimedes' Masterpiece: On the Sphere and Cylinder**: Archimedes proved in 225 BC that a sphere inscribed inside a cylinder has exactly two-thirds the volume and two-thirds the surface area of the cylinder: V_sphere = ⅔ · V_cylinder = ⅔ · (πr² · 2r) = 4/3 · π · r³.
  - **Surface Area Derivative**: The derivative of volume with respect to radius equals the surface area: dV/dr = d/dr(4/3 π r³) = 4πr².
  - **Isoperimetric Supremacy**: Among all three-dimensional shapes enclosing a given volume, the sphere possesses the absolute minimum surface area, minimizing surface tension energy.

### Torus Volume & Surface Area (Donut) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/torus/`)
- Governing Formula: `Volume = 2π² · R · r² | Surface Area = 4π² · R · r`
  - **Pappus's First Centroid Theorem (Volume)**: Volume equals cross-sectional area multiplied by the distance traveled by its geometric centroid: Area_circle = πr². Centroid path = 2πR. Therefore: V = (πr²) · (2πR) = 2π² · R · r².
  - **Pappus's Second Centroid Theorem (Surface Area)**: Surface area equals perimeter of cross-section multiplied by distance traveled by its centroid: Perimeter = 2πr. Centroid path = 2πR. Therefore: A = (2πr) · (2πR) = 4π² · R · r.
  - **Ring Torus Geometric Condition**: When R > r, the torus forms a standard ring torus with an open central aperture; when R = r, it forms a horn torus touching at the origin; when R < r, it is a spindle torus self-intersecting internally.

### Triangular Prism Volume & Surface Area Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/triangular-prism/`)
- Governing Formula: `Volume = Base Area · Length | Total Area = 2 · Base Area + (a + b + c) · Length`
  - **Uniform Cross-Section Volumetric Extrusion**: The volume of any right prism equals the area of its base polygon multiplied by its length: A_base = ½ · b · h. Volume V = A_base · L = ½ · b · h · L.
  - **Lateral Wall Area**: Assuming an isosceles triangular cross-section with slanted leg s = √[(b/2)² + h²], the perimeter is P_base = b + 2s. Lateral Area = P_base · L.
  - **Total Closed Net**: Total Area = (2 × A_base) + Lateral Area.

### Square Pyramid Volume & Slant Height Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/pyramid/`)
- Governing Formula: `Volume = ⅓ · a² · h | Slant Height s = √[h² + (a/2)²]`
  - **Pyramidal Volume Proof**: Three congruent pyramids assemble exactly into a cube or square prism of identical base and height: Volume = ⅓ · a² · h.
  - **Lateral Face Altitude via Pythagorean Theorem**: The vertical height h, apothem of base a/2, and slant height s form a right triangle: s = √[h² + (a/2)²].
  - **Four Triangular Faces Net**: Lateral Area = 4 × [½ · a · s] = 2 · a · s. Total Area = a² + 2as.

### Frustum of a Cone (Truncated Cone) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/frustum-cone/`)
- Governing Formula: `Volume = ⅓ · π · h · (R² + Rr + r²) | Slant Height s = √[h² + (R - r)²]`
  - **Subtractive Conical Calculus**: A frustum is formed by subtracting a small cone of height h₁ from a full cone of height h₂ = h + h₁. By similar triangles, r/R = h₁ / (h + h₁). Integrating slices: V = ⅓ · π · h · (R² + Rr + r²).
  - **Slant Pythagorean Relation**: The difference in radii (R - r) forms the base of a right triangle with altitude h: Slant Height s = √[h² + (R - r)²].
  - **Lateral Surface Sector Difference**: Lateral Area A_lat = π(R + r)s. Total Area = A_lat + πR² + πr².

### Frustum of a Pyramid (Truncated Pyramid) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/frustum-pyramid/`)
- Governing Formula: `Volume = ⅓ · h · (A₁ + A₂ + √(A₁ · A₂))`
  - **The Moscow Mathematical Papyrus (Problem 14)**: Dating to 1850 BC, Problem 14 in the Egyptian Moscow Papyrus provides the exact modern formula: V = ⅓ · h · (a₁² + a₁a₂ + a₂²).
  - **Geometric Mean Base Cross-Section**: For any truncated pyramid with top area A₂ and bottom area A₁: Volume V = ⅓ · h · [A₁ + A₂ + √(A₁ · A₂)].
  - **Lateral Trapezoidal Faces**: Each of the 4 lateral faces is an isosceles trapezoid with bases a₁ and a₂ and altitude s = √[h² + ((a₁ - a₂)/2)²]. Lateral Area = 4 × [½(a₁ + a₂)s] = 2(a₁ + a₂)s.

### Ellipsoid Volume & Surface Area Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/ellipsoid/`)
- Governing Formula: `Volume = 4/3 · π · a · b · c | Surface Area ≈ 4π · [((ab)^p + (ac)^p + (bc)^p) / 3]^(1/p), p ≈ 1.6075`
  - **Ellipsoid Volume Integral**: Subjecting the unit sphere x² + y² + z² ≤ 1 to the linear stretch matrix diag(a, b, c): V = 4/3 · π · a · b · c. This formula is exact for all ellipsoids.
  - **Knud Thomsen Surface Area Formula**: Because exact surface area requires incomplete elliptic integrals of the first and second kind, Knud Thomsen devised the formula: Area ≈ 4π · [((ab)ᵖ + (ac)ᵖ + (bc)ᵖ) / 3]^(1/p), where optimal parameter p = ln(3)/ln(2) ≈ 1.6075.
  - **Bound on Relative Error**: Thomsen's formula bounds maximum relative error to less than 1.061% over all possible triaxial geometries.

### Arc Length, Sector Area & Chord Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/geometry/arc-length/`)
- Governing Formula: `Arc Length s = r · θ (rad) = [π · r · θ°] / 180° | Sector Area = ½ · r² · θ`
  - **Radian Definition and Arc Length**: One radian is defined as the central angle subtending an arc equal in length to the circle's radius. Converting degrees to radians: θ_rad = θ° · (π / 180°). Arc Length s = r · θ_rad.
  - **Sector Area Derivation**: Sector area is proportional to the fraction of the full circle: Area_sector = (θ° / 360°) · πr² = ½ · r² · θ_rad.
  - **Chord Length and Segment Area**: Bisecting the isosceles triangle formed by the radius arms yields chord length: c = 2r · sin(θ / 2). Circular Segment Area = Area_sector - Area_triangle = ½ · r² · (θ_rad - sin θ_rad).

### Projectile Motion & Ballistic Trajectory Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/physics/projectile-motion/`)
- Governing Formula: `Range R = [v₀² · sin(2θ)] / g | Max Height H = [v₀² · sin²(θ)] / (2g)`
  - **Orthogonal Vector Velocity Decomposition**: Horizontal velocity: v_x = v₀ · cos(θ). Vertical velocity: v_y = v₀ · sin(θ). In vacuum kinematics, horizontal velocity remains constant (a_x = 0).
  - **Apogee Altitude and Vertical Ascent Time**: At maximum height, vertical velocity drops to zero (v_y = 0): t_apex = (v₀ sin θ) / g. Peak height H = y₀ + (v₀² sin² θ) / 2g.
  - **Quadratic Ground Impact Time**: Solving y(t) = y₀ + (v₀ sin θ)t - ½gt² = 0 for positive root t_impact yields total flight duration. Range R = v_x · t_impact.

### Kinetic Energy & Linear Momentum Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/physics/kinetic-energy/`)
- Governing Formula: `Kinetic Energy E_k = ½ · m · v² | Momentum p = m · v`
  - **Work-Energy Theorem Derivation**: Work done on a mass is the line integral of force: W = ∫ F dx = ∫ (m · dv/dt) dx = m ∫ v dv = ½ · m · v².
  - **Quadratic Velocity Scaling**: Because velocity is squared, doubling vehicle speed quadruples (4×) required braking distance and collision impact energy.
  - **Momentum Relationship**: Linear momentum p = mv. Kinetic energy can be expressed via momentum as E_k = p² / (2m). 1 Joule = 0.737562 ft-lbs.

### Ohm's Law & Electrical Power (PIVR) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/physics/ohms-law/`)
- Governing Formula: `V = I · R | Power P = V · I = I² · R = V² / R`
  - **Drude Electron Conduction Model**: Discovered experimentally by Georg Ohm in 1827: Current I through a conductor between two points is directly proportional to voltage V and inversely proportional to resistance R: I = V / R.
  - **Joule Heating and Thermodynamic Power**: Joule's first law defines electrical power dissipation: P = V · I. Substituting Ohm's law yields P = (IR) · I = I²R = V² / R.
  - **Four-Quadrant PIVR Matrix Invariant**: Given any two known variables among {P, I, V, R}, all remaining parameters are resolved through twelve deterministic algebraic substitutions.

### Density, Mass & Volume Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/physics/density-mass-volume/`)
- Governing Formula: `Density ρ = Mass / Volume | Mass = ρ · Volume | Volume = Mass / ρ`
  - **Continuum Intensive Property**: Density ρ = dm / dV. Unlike mass and volume which are extensive variables, density is an intensive physical property invariant to sample quantity.
  - **Specific Gravity and Buoyancy**: Specific Gravity SG = ρ_substance / ρ_H2O (at 4°C, where ρ_water = 1,000 kg/m³ = 1.0 g/cm³).
  - **Archimedes' Buoyancy Principle**: An object submerged in fluid experiences an upward buoyant force equal to the weight of the displaced fluid: F_buoyant = ρ_fluid · V · g. If SG < 1.0, the object floats; if SG > 1.0, it sinks.

### Quadratic Formula & Parabola Vertex Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/calculus/quadratic-formula/`)
- Governing Formula: `Roots x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / (2a) | Discriminant Δ = b² - 4ac`
  - **Completing the Square Proof**: Dividing ax² + bx + c = 0 by a yields x² + (b/a)x = -c/a. Adding (b/2a)² to both sides: [x + b/2a]² = (b² - 4ac) / 4a². Taking square roots yields the iconic formula x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / 2a.
  - **Discriminant Root Characterization**: If Δ > 0: Two distinct real roots. If Δ = 0: Exactly one repeated real root (tangent to x-axis). If Δ < 0: Two conjugate complex roots x = -b/2a ± i√(4ac - b²) / 2a.
  - **Vertex Calculus Extrema**: Differentiating dy/dx = 2ax + b = 0 gives the vertex axis of symmetry: h = -b / (2a), and minimum/maximum value k = c - b² / (4a).

### Standard Deviation & Variance Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/statistics/standard-deviation/`)
- Governing Formula: `Sample s = √[∑(xᵢ - x̄)² / (n - 1)] | Population σ = √[∑(xᵢ - μ)² / N]`
  - **Mean Centering Transformation**: The sample mean x̄ = (1/n) ∑ xᵢ. Deviations from mean dᵢ = xᵢ - x̄.
  - **Bessel's Correction for Unbiased Variance**: Dividing by n underestimates population variance because deviations are calculated from the sample mean rather than true population mean μ. Bessel's correction divides by (n - 1) degrees of freedom to yield an unbiased estimator: s² = ∑ dᵢ² / (n - 1).
  - **Standard Deviation Metric**: Standard deviation s = √(s²) returns dispersion back to original measurement units.

### Z-Score & Standard Normal Distribution Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/statistics/z-score/`)
- Governing Formula: `z = (x - μ) / σ | Φ(z) = ½ · [1 + erf(z / √2)]`
  - **Standardization Normalization**: The z-score measures how many standard deviations a raw observation x lies above or below the mean: z = (x - μ) / σ.
  - **Gaussian Cumulative Distribution Function**: Cumulative probability Φ(z) = (1 / √2π) ∫₋∞ᶻ e^(-t²/2) dt = ½[1 + erf(z / √2)], where erf is the Gauss error function.
  - **Hypothesis Testing Benchmark**: In two-tailed hypothesis testing, |z| ≥ 1.96 corresponds to p ≤ 0.05 (statistical significance), and |z| ≥ 2.576 corresponds to p ≤ 0.01.

### Permutations & Combinations (nPr & nCr) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/statistics/permutations-combinations/`)
- Governing Formula: `nPr = n! / (n - r)! | nCr = n! / [r! · (n - r)!]`
  - **Fundamental Counting Principle**: Selecting r elements in order from n items yields n choices for the first, (n - 1) for the second, ..., down to (n - r + 1): nPr = n! / (n - r)!.
  - **Symmetry and Division of Redundancy**: If order is irrelevant, each group of r items can be arranged in r! identical ways: nCr = nPr / r! = n! / [r! · (n - r)!].
  - **Pascal's Recurrence Identity**: Binomial coefficients satisfy Pascal's rule: nCr = (n-1)C(r-1) + (n-1)Cr, mapping directly to rows of Pascal's Triangle.

### Bayes' Theorem & Conditional Probability Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/statistics/bayes-theorem/`)
- Governing Formula: `P(A|B) = [P(B|A) · P(A)] / P(B)`
  - **Conditional Probability Definition**: Joint probability P(A ∩ B) = P(A|B) · P(B) = P(B|A) · P(A). Equating both sides yields Bayes' Theorem: P(A|B) = [P(B|A) · P(A)] / P(B).
  - **Law of Total Probability**: The marginal evidence probability partitions across mutually exclusive hypotheses: P(B) = P(B|A) · P(A) + P(B|¬A) · P(¬A), where P(¬A) = 1 - P(A).
  - **Base Rate Fallacy Resolution**: When prior probability P(A) is very low (e.g. rare disease or rare defect), even a test with 95% sensitivity produces predominantly false positive signals.

### 2×2 Matrix Determinant & Inverse Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/calculus/matrix-multiplication/`)
- Governing Formula: `det(A) = ad - bc | A⁻¹ = [1 / det(A)] · [ [d, -b], [-c, a] ]`
  - **Geometric Area Scaling Factor**: The determinant of a 2×2 matrix represents the signed factor by which area scales under the linear transformation: det(A) = ad - bc.
  - **Cramer's Rule Adjugate Matrix Inversion**: By the adjugate matrix formula: A⁻¹ = (1 / det A) · adj(A) = (1 / (ad - bc)) · [ [d, -b], [-c, a] ].
  - **Singular Matrix Non-Invertibility**: If det(A) = 0, the transformation collapses two-dimensional space onto a line or point; hence the matrix is singular and no inverse exists.

### Simple Pendulum Period & Harmonic Frequency Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/physics/pendulum-period/`)
- Governing Formula: `Period T = 2π · √(L / g) | Frequency f = 1 / T`
  - **Torque Restoring Differential Equation**: Net restoring torque τ = -m · g · L · sin(θ). For small angles (θ < 15°), sin(θ) ≈ θ (first-order Taylor series approximation), yielding linear differential equation: d²θ/dt² + (g/L)θ = 0.
  - **Simple Harmonic Motion Solution**: Angular frequency ω = √(g / L). Period T = 2π / ω = 2π · √(L / g).
  - **Mass Invariance of Gravitational Pendulums**: Galileo Galilei discovered in 1581 that period T is completely independent of the pendulum bob's mass, confirming the equivalence principle between inertial and gravitational mass.

### Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/cac/`)
- Governing Formula: `CAC = Total Sales & Marketing Spend / Number of New Customers Acquired`
  - **Direct S&M Capital Consolidation**: Total acquisition expenditure C_total = Marketing Spend + Sales Team Costs (salaries, commissions, CRM overhead, and paid ad media).
  - **Cohort Unit Economics Ratio**: CAC = C_total / N_acquired. Dividing total capital deployed by the cohort of acquired paying accounts yields average unit acquisition cost.
  - **Blended vs Paid Segmentation**: Blended CAC incorporates organic word-of-mouth users; Paid CAC isolates strictly direct paid channel acquisition efficiency.

### Customer Lifetime Value (LTV / CLV) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/clv-ltv/`)
- Governing Formula: `LTV = (ARPU × Gross Margin %) / Churn Rate`
  - **Customer Lifespan Geometric Series**: Assuming a constant monthly churn rate c, average customer lifespan in months is T = 1 / c (e.g. 1 / 0.025 = 40 months).
  - **Gross Margin Adjusted Revenue Contribution**: Net revenue contribution per month M = ARPA · (Gross Margin% / 100).
  - **Lifetime Economic Value**: LTV = M · T = [ARPA · Gross Margin%] / Churn. Gross margin adjustment is mandatory to prevent inflating lifetime value with delivery cost.

### LTV:CAC Ratio & Payback Period Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/ltv-cac-ratio/`)
- Governing Formula: `LTV:CAC = Customer Lifetime Value / CAC | Payback Months = CAC / (ARPA × Gross Margin %)`
  - **Unit Economic Multiplier**: LTV:CAC Ratio = LTV / CAC. Benchmarks: < 1.0 = Value destructive; 1.0–2.9 = Sub-optimal margin; 3.0–5.0 = Gold standard scalable growth; > 5.0 = Under-investing in acquisition.
  - **Cash Flow Payback Period**: Payback Period in Months = CAC / (ARPA × Gross Margin%). Measures how many months of customer subscription cash flow are required to recover upfront marketing and sales cash outflows.
  - **Net Economic Profit Contribution**: Net Capital Surplus = LTV - CAC. Represents net scalable profit returned per customer account.

### Customer & Revenue Churn Rate Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/churn-rate/`)
- Governing Formula: `Customer Churn % = (Customers Lost / Starting Customers) × 100`
  - **Monthly Logo Churn Formulation**: Customer Churn Rate c_mo = Lost Customers / Starting Customers. Measures account attrition rate.
  - **Compound Annualized Churn Curve**: Because churn compounds each period, annualized churn is non-linear: c_annual = 1 - (1 - c_mo)¹². For example, 2.5% monthly churn produces 1 - (0.975)¹² = 26.24% annual account loss.
  - **Net Revenue Retention (NRR)**: NRR = [(Starting MRR - Churned MRR + Expansion MRR) / Starting MRR] × 100%. NRR above 100% indicates that expansion revenue outpaces churn.

### MRR to ARR & Net New MRR Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/mrr-arr/`)
- Governing Formula: `ARR = MRR × 12 | Net New MRR = New MRR + Expansion MRR - Contraction MRR - Churned MRR`
  - **Annual Run Rate Equivalence**: ARR = MRR × 12. Annualizes recurring monthly cash subscriptions.
  - **Net New MRR Decomposition**: Net New MRR = (New MRR + Expansion MRR) - (Contraction MRR + Churned MRR).
  - **Revenue Growth Quality Assessment**: High-efficiency SaaS organizations maintain Quick Ratios: Quick Ratio = (New MRR + Expansion MRR) / (Contraction MRR + Churned MRR) > 4.0.

### Startup Cash Runway & Burn Rate Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/runway-burn/`)
- Governing Formula: `Runway (Months) = Current Cash Balance / Net Monthly Burn Rate`
  - **Gross vs Net Burn Differential**: Gross Burn = Total Monthly Cash Operating Expenses. Net Burn = Gross Expenses - Monthly Cash Collections.
  - **Runway Derivation**: Runway (Months) = Cash Balance / Net Burn Rate. Represents exact timeline until Zero Cash Date (ZCD).
  - **Fundraising Buffer Heuristic**: Because institutional Series A/B venture capital rounds average 4 to 6 months to close, founders must kick off fundraising when runway reaches 6 months.

### SaaS Magic Number & Sales Efficiency Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/saas-magic-number/`)
- Governing Formula: `Magic Number = [(Q_curr Revenue - Q_prev Revenue) × 4] / Q_prev Sales & Marketing`
  - **Quarterly Sequential Net ARR Growth**: Annualized New ARR Generated = (Revenue_Q - Revenue_Q-1) × 4.
  - **Magic Number Ratio**: Magic Number = [Annualized Net New ARR] / Sales & Marketing Expense_Q-1.
  - **Benchmark Allocation Heuristic**: < 0.5 = Broken model (evaluate churn and pricing); 0.5–0.75 = Acceptable efficiency; 0.75–1.0 = Strong unit economics; > 1.0 = Pour gas on the fire (sales capacity pays back in under 12 months).

### SaaS Rule of 40 Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/saas-rule-of-40/`)
- Governing Formula: `Rule of 40 Score = YoY Revenue Growth Rate (%) + Profit Margin (%)`
  - **The Rule of 40 Equation**: Rule of 40 = Growth Rate% + Free Cash Flow Margin%. For example: 45% growth + 5% FCF margin = 50% score.
  - **Growth vs Profit Trade-off**: A SaaS business can operate at negative margins (e.g. -20% FCF) if its growth rate is high enough (e.g. 65% growth = 45% score) and remain an elite financial asset.
  - **Enterprise Multiple Valuation Elasticity**: Public market data shows companies beating the Rule of 40 trade at median enterprise value to revenue multiples 2× to 3× higher than sub-40 peers.

### Net Promoter Score (NPS) Calculator (`https://omnioperand.com/finance/net-promoter-score/`)
- Governing Formula: `NPS = % Promoters (9-10) - % Detractors (0-6)`
  - **Response Partitioning**: Total Respondents N = Promoters + Passives + Detractors.
